claim: Coca-Cola reports $12 million revenue for fiscal third quarter of 2023
summary: Coca-Cola's Q3 2023 revenue was on the order of $12 billion, not $12 million. The claim understates revenue by ~1000x due to million vs billion error and is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Coca-Cola reported results for fiscal third quarter of 2023
sub_claims.note: Coca-Cola reports on a quarterly basis with fiscal year ending December, so fiscal Q3 2023 exists as July-September 2023 period.

sub_claims.text: Coca-Cola's revenue for fiscal Q3 2023 was $12 million
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge Coca-Cola quarterly net operating revenues are on the order of $10-12 billion; Q3 2023 was about $12 billion (~$11.9B), not $12 million - off by factor of ~1000, million vs billion unit error.
